PENANCEMOD-CURSE_OF_WOLVES.description: A special Curse card. Automatically played when drawn.
PENANCEMOD-CURSE_OF_WOLVES.title: Wolfpack Curse
PENANCEMOD-BARRIER.description: A special defensive value. When Block is depleted, Barrier absorbs the remaining damage. Barrier does not expire at the end of your turn.
PENANCEMOD-BARRIER.title: Barrier
PENANCEMOD-JUDGEMENT.description: Whenever your Barrier takes damage from an enemy, deal damage equal to your #yJudgment to the attacker.
PENANCEMOD-JUDGEMENT.title: Judgment
PENANCEMOD-THORN_AURA.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your #yThorn #yAura.
PENANCEMOD-THORN_AURA.title: Thorn Aura
PENANCEMOD-CEASE_FIRE.description: Players with #yArmistice cannot play Attacks. Enemies with #yArmistice will skip their turn if they intend to attack.
PENANCEMOD-CEASE_FIRE.title: Armistice
PENANCEMOD-JUSTIFIED_DEFENSE.description: While this ability is active, gain additional Energy and draw cards whenever you take damage.
PENANCEMOD-JUSTIFIED_DEFENSE.title: Self-Defense
